annotations.text:
WHITE, LOUD, FAST

Pure white ground, one electric accent doing the work, and huge tight display type. Colour only where something is happening.

Buttons are chunky pills that physically press down onto their own shadow. Sound is built live in the page — turn it up.

Left to right is the player's whole run.

The whole reward beat lives here: a check that punches in with a shockwave ring, points counting up, confetti, then the next clue rising.

Hit "Play that again" to replay it.

COMMAND — the organiser's side

The hunt is a node graph on a dotted canvas: click any card to load it into the editor on the right. The animated dashes show which branches are live.

Race Control runs the day — light map, vivid crew trails, alerts colour-coded by how much they should worry you. Try the pause button.

Crew names, clue text and scores are sample copy, not real event data.
